assertion_scope: named synthetic assertion against the frozen bounded reference; not whole-scenario acceptance

determinism.assertion: normalised observation of run 1 equals run 2 under unchanged conditions

atomic-claim-executor.what: AtomicLocalControlPlaneExecutor + AtomicAuthorityEffectDestination claims (route B, run_matched_refund route)

control-plane-local-destination.what: BoundedAuthorizationWorkflow.execute against the Control Plane LocalRefundDestination (no runtime executor)

cp-pinned-executor.what: Control Plane revalidation + PinnedControlPlaneExecutor + EffectiveGrantDestination (route A)

direct-commit-bypass.what: direct DurableRefundDestination.commit / LocalDestinationExecutor.execute_snapshot / adapter.apply on an effective-grant destination

exchange-run_exchange.what: governed-exchange run_exchange ingress; drives route A internally (route C)

legacy-agent-engine.what: legacy AgentEngine.execute_action shell (declared to perform no side effect)

legacy-cli.not_exercised_reason: legacy CLI; statically asserted below to reference no destination/executor route

legacy-write-on-atomic-profile.what: legacy DurableRefundDestination write path on an atomic-claim database
